protocol: RARM Figure-5 public protocol with public native reward definitions
scope: one fixed held-out success/failure pair; not an accuracy estimate
time_grid: same 16 exact control times for every method
normalization: both trajectories divided by that method's own success-rollout final cumulative reward

methods.reward_definition: Official VIP reward: negative Euclidean distance from the current agentview embedding to the independent reference-goal embedding.
Official Robometer LIBERO wrapper default: absolute predicted progress returned directly (use_relative_rewards=False).
Official public recommendation: average the incremental-, forward-, and backward-mode hop/reward outputs.
Predeclared local Jev contract: reward only an increase beyond the prior best probability-weighted absolute-progress estimate.
